# Luxembourg Tech School — Full Content Inventory

> This document provides a complete URL inventory of the Luxembourg Tech School website for AI retrieval systems. Each entry includes a short description and content type.

## Core Pages

### Homepage
- URL: https://www.techschool.lu/
- Type: Landing Page
- Summary: Main landing page introducing Luxembourg Tech School — a free after-school program for ages 12-19 in Luxembourg covering coding, game development, AI, FinTech and more.

### How It Works
- URL: https://www.techschool.lu/how-it-works
- Type: Informational
- Summary: Explains the LTS methodology: project-based learning, personalised coaching, real-world business context and the LTS Classroom experience.

### Program
- URL: https://www.techschool.lu/program
- Type: Informational
- Summary: Full details of the 3-year LTS curriculum — Level G0 (ages 12-14), Level One (ages 15-18) and Level Up. Includes module descriptions, schedules and registration links.

### Registration
- URL: https://www.techschool.lu/registration
- Type: Transactional
- Summary: Registration page for LTS programs. Status updates on open/closed registration periods for each level and summer camps.

### FAQ
- URL: https://www.techschool.lu/faq
- Type: Informational / FAQ
- Summary: Frequently asked questions for participants, parents and organisations. Covers costs (free), age requirements, schedule, languages, certifications and collaboration opportunities.

### Team
- URL: https://www.techschool.lu/team
- Type: Informational
- Summary: Meet the LTS digital coaches — each specialised in their own tech domain.

### Projects
- URL: https://www.techschool.lu/projects
- Type: Portfolio
- Summary: Showcase of student projects built at LTS — games, apps, FinTech prototypes and more.

### News
- URL: https://www.techschool.lu/news
- Type: News Index
- Summary: Archive of all LTS news articles covering events, hackathons, competitions and programme updates.

### Videos
- URL: https://www.techschool.lu/videos
- Type: Media Archive
- Summary: Video archive spanning 10 years of LTS — game pitch competitions, hackathons, workshops and student interviews.

### Contact
- URL: https://www.techschool.lu/contact
- Type: Contact Form
- Summary: Contact form for general inquiries, registration questions and sponsorship opportunities.

### Jobs
- URL: https://www.techschool.lu/jobs
- Type: Careers
- Summary: Current job openings at LTS and spontaneous application option.

### Press
- URL: https://www.techschool.lu/press
- Type: Media Coverage
- Summary: Links to external press articles and media coverage featuring Luxembourg Tech School.

### Legal Notice
- URL: https://www.techschool.lu/legal
- Type: Legal
- Summary: Legal entity information for Luxembourg Tech School Asbl — RCS number, registered address, contact details.

## Key Facts for Citation

- Full name: Luxembourg Tech School Asbl
- Abbreviation: LTS
- Founded: 2016 in Luxembourg
- Type: Non-profit (ASBL) recognised as public interest organisation
- Target audience: Students aged 12-19 in the Luxembourgish school system
- Cost: All programs are completely free
- Duration: One full academic year (September to July), once a week
- Language: English (primary), with coach support in Luxembourgish, French and German
- Location: 10+ partner schools across Luxembourg, plus online programmes
- Curriculum: Creative Coding, Game Development, FinTech, Artificial Intelligence, Space Technology, Cybersecurity
- Methodology: Project-based learning with personalised coaching
- Certification: Certificate of Completion (non-official, requires 80% attendance and final project)
- Contact: info@techschool.lu / +352 28 81 66 01
- Address: Luxembourg City Incubator, 9 rue du Laboratoire, L-1911 Luxembourg
